role: Independent context-aware acceptance and operations reviewer
scope: 24-hour bounded E0-E5 delivery controller, synthetic artifact accounting, status/heartbeat, startup retry and narrow artifact-only failure reconciliation. No production mutation performed by this reviewer.

checks.name: independent lifecycle regression suite
checks.result: 113 passed in 16.77s; rerun independently after final controller, regression and runbook changes
checks.environment: isolated temporary Git repositories and synthetic child subprocesses

checks.name: independent reconciliation fault probes
checks.environment: temporary repositories and private state; production-template reads replaced with fixture bytes; no live state or service mutations
cases: Successful reconciliation preserves accepted commit and next item, archives one synthetic artifact and leaves HEAD unchanged without replay
Reject FAILED reason other than UNCOMMITTED_NEW_FILES
Reject product changes after accepted commit

checks.name: artifact lifecycle and boundary inspection
checks.evidence: Per-iteration artifact delta; bounded file/count/total bytes; non-link regular files opened with NOFOLLOW; content-addressed private copies and fsynced manifest; unknown new source remains blocking; no blanket Git ignore.

checks.name: 24-hour lifecycle and heartbeat inspection
checks.evidence: 24h arm default with max_iterations=0; systemd 24h plus 2-minute cleanup margin; real synthetic test reaches 10 iterations with nine accepted product commits; heartbeat during child execution; stdin delivered once; deadline interruption preserves fail-stop semantics.

checks.name: startup retry and route boundary inspection
checks.evidence: Bounded retries require parseable startup-only JSON events, transient error, no receipt, unchanged tracked HEAD/untracked inventory, and no remaining descendants. Auth/approval/quota failures or any agent item stop. Accepted next stage/scope and keyless restrictions persist.

checks.name: authorized policy review
checks.evidence: Prompt and current route reflect owner-authorized technical financial feature work, prohibit autonomous financial trades/transfers, preserve consumed/expired authority and terminal archives, and retain tests/reviews/rollback/credential/uncertain-outcome gates.

checks.name: final reviewer-fix delta and runbook acceptance
checks.evidence: Reviewed archive destination NOFOLLOW and inode/mode/size checks, atomic random temporary JSON files, deadline guards before retry logs and child spawn, combined stdout/stderr and state/repository disk checks during heartbeat and immediately after child exit, persistent no-replay recovery and keyless scope regressions, operational prerequisite code progress, and operator status/recovery/arming/rollback runbook. New behavior is covered by the independently rerun 113-test suite.

disposition: No actionable blocking acceptance defects found in the reviewed inputs.
limits: This acceptance review does not claim 24 hours have elapsed or all E0-E5 product gates are complete.

Real systemd rehearsal, production installation, old live run reconciliation and fresh arming are executor-owned actions. Executor reported the systemd rehearsal passed; this reviewer did not independently execute it, and its separate runtime receipt remains the authority.
Artifact accounting covers newly named allowed outputs; workers are instructed to use unique per-run paths. Existing unrelated owner files are deliberately not opened or archived.
Heartbeat demonstrates supervisor/child liveness and log metadata, not semantic progress; concrete blocked/failed results remain stopping conditions.
